## Connections that drive true transformation.

Real progress happens when the right things come together: expertise and data, insights and human
ingenuity, the physical and the digital. At Honeywell Technologies, we make these connections real,
turning isolated intelligence into coordinated action.
[Multiple gas storage tanks are lined up, showcasing safety ladders and railings for secure access.]

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real
consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing
safety on site.]

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we
harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that
continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes
improvements, and acts only with their approval.

  healthcare ecosystem including providers: ambulatory clinics, acute care
  hospitals; payers: insurance companies, governments;  and public health and regulatory agencies.
  
  **Healthcare Applications**
  
  Ambulatory Care System for Clinics
  Acute Care System for Hospitals

  These are modern SaaS applications with built-in AI, machine learning, and analytics. These
  industry applications integrate seamlessly with core business functions in Fusion ERP, HCM, Supply
  Chain, Finance, and Customer Experience. Here are a few examples:
  
  **Banking Suite**
  
  Includes core banking, anti-money laundering, risk management, compliance, and AI analytics.
  
  **Construction and Engineering**
  
  Includes project management, procurement, supplier analytics, subcontractor payments, cost
  controls, and more.
  
  **Retail Suite**

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.

technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

## ALSO has the right offer for you

Create holistic IT solutions with ALSO. Innovative applications from IoT to AI, from cybersecurity

[AI-Era Software Solutions]

Altoros is an engineering partner for companies putting AI and modern software to work inside real
business models — safely. Altoros's senior engineers take a build from whiteboard to production:
reliable core flows, predictable cost, faster shipping, without giving up security or compliance.

## Key solutions

Pick the solution to the problem in front of you. Three run on Altoros's Forward Deployed
Engineering (FDE) model — one senior engineer, fixed price, paid on the result; the fourth adds
vetted engineers to your team.

[AI-first Software Solutions]

### AI-first Software Solutions

Full-cycle engineering for SaaS, enterprise systems, and internal software tools — discovery,
architecture, build, and deploy — with AI built into how Altoros works, not bolted on. Altoros
starts with a working prototype fast, proves it against the metric you care about, then hardens it
for production. One senior FDE owns the build end to end, the price is fixed before kickoff, and you
own the code and the AI accounts throughout.

[See if this solves your case →][100]
[Software Subscription Optimization]

### Software Subscription Optimization

Recurring subscription costs climb every year — per-seat pricing, renewals, and tools that never
quite fit how you actually work. Altoros uses its AI and integration capabilities to bring that
spend down: connecting the systems you keep, and building custom software you own to replace the
tools you're overpaying for — saving up to 70% of that spend.

[See the example with your numbers →][101]
[AI Recovery & Scaling]

### AI Recovery & Scaling

AI-assisted builds ship fast, then stall on the "money path" — auth loops, broken checkout, fragile
integrations, costs that swing. A senior FDE stabilizes the revenue-critical flows so your team can
ship again, then takes the same build to production scale: evals, observability, cost controls, and
a tested fallback for when a model misbehaves.

[Request help →][102]
[Integration & Staff Augmentation]

[Discuss your project][99]
1,400

[AI-Era Software Solutions]

Altoros is an engineering partner for companies putting AI and modern software to work inside real
business models — safely. Altoros's senior engineers take a build from whiteboard to production:
reliable core flows, predictable cost, faster shipping, without giving up security or compliance.

## Key solutions

Pick the solution to the problem in front of you. Three run on Altoros's Forward Deployed
Engineering (FDE) model — one senior engineer, fixed price, paid on the result; the fourth adds
vetted engineers to your team.

[AI-first Software Solutions]

### AI-first Software Solutions

Full-cycle engineering for SaaS, enterprise systems, and internal software tools — discovery,
architecture, build, and deploy — with AI built into how Altoros works, not bolted on. Altoros
starts with a working prototype fast, proves it against the metric you care about, then hardens it
for production. One senior FDE owns the build end to end, the price is fixed before kickoff, and you
own the code and the AI accounts throughout.

[See if this solves your case →][100]
[Software Subscription Optimization]

### Software Subscription Optimization

Recurring subscription costs climb every year — per-seat pricing, renewals, and tools that never
quite fit how you actually work. Altoros uses its AI and integration capabilities to bring that
spend down: connecting the systems you keep, and building custom software you own to replace the
tools you're overpaying for — saving up to 70% of that spend.

[See the example with your numbers →][101]
[AI Recovery & Scaling]

### AI Recovery & Scaling

AI-assisted builds ship fast, then stall on the "money path" — auth loops, broken checkout, fragile
integrations, costs that swing. A senior FDE stabilizes the revenue-critical flows so your team can
ship again, then takes the same build to production scale: evals, observability, cost controls, and
a tested fallback for when a model misbehaves.

[Request help →][102]
[Integration & Staff Augmentation]

### Integration & Staff Augmentation

Integrate scattered services to meet your business needs, and bridge traditional Web2 platforms with
Web3 — blockchain modules and tokenized assets — without breaking existing operations. Enrich your
team with vetted engineers and cross-functional specialists, from frontend and backend to QA,
DevOps, and cloud.

[Tell Altoros what you need to connect or staff →][103]

## Fast, effective, safe

Altoros matches how it builds to your product and your compliance reality. Three modes: full-AI
acceleration for rapid prototyping; AI-assisted engineering with strong guardrails for production;
and no-AI development when policy, IP, or regulation require it. In every mode Altoros builds for
reliability, observability, security, and maintainability — so the software keeps working after it
ships.

### Two months in, problem's where it was

A problem is costing you money or holding back growth. You call a vendor, and step one is always a
1–2 month discovery — 3–5 people billed by the hour, whether or not it gets you closer. You pay
three times: money, time to market, and knowledge-transfer overhead per head. Worst case, eight
weeks and $100K in, a third of it pure communication overhead, and all you have is a task list.

02

### Software subscription overspend.

How's your subscription spend trending versus two or three years ago? For most teams it only climbs
— even where usage didn't. And the bill is only part of it: overlapping tools, the integration glue
between them, onboarding, training. Count the full picture and it's rarely pretty.

03

AI-assisted builds demo well, then collapse on the money path — login loops, broken checkout and
upgrade flows, fragile integrations, costs that swing. You've inherited a codebase that's hard to
own, hard to change, and risky to scale once real users arrive.

# CEUR Workshop Proceedings (CEUR-WS.org)

## Free Open-Access Proceedings for Computer Science Workshops

Unless stated explicitely and in conformance to the legal [Disclaimer][22] of CEUR-WS.org, the
copyright for the workshop proceedings as a compilation, i.e. CEUR-WS.org/Vol-1, CEUR-WS.org/Vol-2
etc., is with the respective proceedings editors. The copyright for the individual *items*
(subsuming any type of computer-represented files containing articles, software demos, videos, etc.)
within a proceedings volume is owned by their respective authors/owners. The open-access license for
a volume is specified in the index file of the respective volume. This license applies by default to
all components in the volume. [ Re-publication][23] of a CEUR Workshop Proceedings volume or of an
individual item inside a proceedings volume requires permission by the copyright owners, i.e. either
the respective proceedings editors, or the authors of the respective item in that volume, or both.
Mirroring of the CEUR-WS.org web site, or parts of it, is prohibited. The label 'CEUR Workshop
Proceedings' and the [CEUR-WS logo][24] are owned by the members of the CEUR-WS Team, represented by
its editor-in-chief. CEUR-WS.org provides its services free of charge to the academic community.
CEUR-WS.org is not run by an organization but by [volunteers][25] from different universities, who
realize the service in their spare time.

Important changes are reported in our [timeline][26]. We are grateful for donations of scripts that
ease our tasks, for example scripts that detect errors in index files.

** Proceedings editors: [Publishing with CEUR-WS: The Happy Path][27] ** covers the recommended
submission steps for a smooth submission process and should suffice in most cases. For additional
details about CEUR-WS submission handling, please refer to the **[instructions on how to
submit][28]** page.

2022-04-05: Due to the ongoing war in Ukraine, CEUR-WS suspends until further notice submissions
from Russian and Belarussian institutions.
2025-01-01: CEUR-WS adopts a new policy about using Generative AI in papers. This policy mandates
that authors: i) declare the use of GenAI tools in the paper, ii) review and edit any AI-generated
content, and iii) not list AI tools as authors. [Read more][29].
2025-06-13: We make the [CEUR-WS Tools][30] available to workshop organizers to check compliance of
paper PDFs and the index.html file with our style.
2025-09-17: GI eV will become the new [sponsor and hoster][31] of CEUR-WS.org. See also [statement
of GI eV][32].
2025-09-18: Our template [Vol-XXX][33] now explains how to add ORCIDs to the volume editors and to
authors. This feature is optional. Workshop organizers can decide not to use it.
2026-04-08: CEUR-WS.org is now physically hosted at GI.de (Gesellschaft für Informatik).

### insights on the business of health tourism and medical travel.

To the extent possible, Maria Todd is committed to equality and access to skills training and
education. She has created and curated learning resources into this broad repository to meet the
many diverse needs of the health tourism industry. Her commitment to learning and professional
development is inspired by UN Article 26 of the 1946 Declaration of Human Rights, which states that
"Education shall be free...". Maria believes in social impact and that one can build a business by
focusing on meeting a global social need and providing skills and education training in health
tourism business development widely accessible for all concerned. The better we are trained, the
higher value to clients and patients we can provide for their safety, quality, and access to
healthcare.

professionals with decades of experience in health tourism business development. Access to
specialised courses is available to anyone by payment of the posted registration fee(s). Visa and
invitation letters are provided after registration. If your visa is denied by the event destination
immigration authorities, a full refund will be timely provided by the same method of payment,
without administrative penalties or withholds. Start the process as early as possible!

A new certification for Qualified Health Tourism Coordinator^{®} (QHTC) for internal staffers and
external contractors of hospitals, surgical centers, airlines and airports, hotels and resorts and
covers competencies required for health tourism business success and patient care continuity and
travel coordination became available in 2020.  The Certification Courses are available online after

# Educate. Advocate. Engage.

### Health Tourism enhances overall traveler spending, generates tourism-related tax revenues,
### provides significant tax relief per household, creates jobs at every skill level, and attracts
### top medical talent and advanced technologies to the community for local healthcare.

### Health Tourism Defined

Health tourism is an experiential product that offers an unforgettable visitor experience. It is
produced by combining carefully coordinated travel to a destination, an opportunity to enjoy the
hospitality of its people, its culture and its history, the rest and rejuvenation of its
accommodations, the unique flavors and recipes of local and regional gastronomy, and the precision
and compassion its health services providers working collaboratively. Together, they produce the
elements to create a unique visitor experience and story-telling value that will be shared for
generations.

produced by combining carefully coordinated travel to a destination, an opportunity to enjoy the
hospitality of its people, its culture and its history, the rest and rejuvenation of its
accommodations, the unique flavors and recipes of local and regional gastronomy, and the precision
and compassion its health services providers working collaboratively. Together, they produce the
elements to create a unique visitor experience and story-telling value that will be shared for

###### temperature profiles giving you absolute control over every aspect of fermentation. These can

## Почему выбирают Soboly?

### Полная конфиденциальность

Мы не сохраняем ваши поисковые запросы и не отслеживаем вашу активность

### Релевантные результаты

Точные и актуальные результаты поиска без рекламных манипуляций

### Быстрая скорость

Мгновенные результаты благодаря оптимизированной системе поиска

## О Soboly

Soboly - это современная поисковая система, созданная с уважением к вашей приватности. Мы верим, что
каждый имеет право на анонимный и безопасный поиск в интернете.

В отличие от традиционных поисковых систем, мы не собираем ваши личные данные, не создаем профили
пользователей и не показываем целевую рекламу.

### 🚫 Мы НЕ делаем
* Не отслеживаем поисковые запросы
* Не сохраняем историю поиска

* Защищаем вашу анонимность
